title: collinsia sparsiflora var. arvensis
intro: Collinsia sparsiflora var. arvensis, commonly known as Western Blue-eyed Mary, is a plant species native to North America. Western Blue-eyed Mary has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, providing health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects. The plant's therapeutic actions include its ability to soothe skin irritations, reduce fever, and act as an expectorant to ease respiratory issues. Its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
